svg.aria-label: Semantics.Strings allocation and relative time per release
svg.text: Deterministic: the same code allocates the same bytes on any machine.
Time, as a multiple of a fixed reference workload
Divided by a reference loop measured in the same job, which cancels most of the difference between CI runners. Lower is faster.
Measured on AMD EPYC 7763, AMD EPYC 9V45, AMD EPYC 9V74, Intel Core i9-14900. Full tables: Semantics.Benchmarks.
